These are reduced, anonymized response fixtures based on read-only checks on
2026-10-13 against `/docs/Index/CH_BGer/last` and `/docs/Jobs/CH_BPatG/last`, plus `_search.php` and `Facetten.json`.
The sort array is a synthetic Elasticsearch cursor example.
Paths, checksums, counts and action/status coverage are synthetic; field locations
and types follow the live responses. They are contract examples, not snapshots
of the complete court collections. No court text or personal data is retained.
